sentences.text: Sonidosaurus was a small titanosaur approximately 9 meters (30 feet) long.
It is the only known sauropod in the Iren Dabasu Fauna.
The fossils were first discovered in 2001 in the Saihangaobi, Iren Dabasu Formation.
The species Sonidosaurus saihangaobiensis was described by Xu and colleagues in 2006.
A 2017 review classified Sonidosaurus as a lithostrotian titanosaur with possible saltasaurid affinities.
Sonidosaurus lived in what is now Inner Mongolia.
It lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
